newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer plans trial of hypertension drugs.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer plans trial of hypertension drugs.

text.p: Pfizer Inc said Tuesday it will sponsor a European clinical trial involving 18,000 patients to compare the effectiveness of new hypertension drugs against older therapies.

The goal of the trial -- one of the largest hypertension studies ever -- is to show reduced rates of heart attack and stroke in patients using new drugs to control high blood pressure, the company said.
The Pfizer drug Norvasc will be included in the study.

Pfizer said the $55 million, five-year study, dubbed the Anglo-Scandinavian Cardiac Outcomes Trial, will involve patients recruited by family physicians in Britain, Ireland, Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark.
A secondary goal of the study is to compare healthcare costs for patients treated with newer agents and those treated with older therapies, Pfizer said.
The trial will also study the effects of using Norvasc for hypertension in combination with the drug Lipitor for high cholesterol.
